purpose: Outcome-blind feasibility receipt for composing Taiwan enterprise cost of capital without duplicating D13-06 or D22-04 evidence.

fieldMatrix.evidence: Repository has strict source-attested Treasury/CBC timing work and requires first-eligible-Taiwan-decision receipts.
fieldMatrix.guard: Consume parent receipt only; never reconstruct a second rate signal in D07-18.

fieldMatrix.evidence: TPEx security-level fair-value/reference lane is verified, but reproducible multi-date transport and actual transaction history remain incomplete.
fieldMatrix.guard: Fair value/reference is not actual trade; no stale mark may be promoted to marginal debt cost without provenance.

fieldMatrix.evidence: Decision-time equity value can be composed from PIT-safe market price and compatible share denominator.
fieldMatrix.guard: Corporate actions and denominator vintages must be aligned; no later share count backfill.

fieldMatrix.evidence: Accounting debt primitives exist; security-level market debt lane is incomplete.
fieldMatrix.guard: Book debt, fair value, quote and trade are distinct provenance states.

fieldMatrix.evidence: D07-26 remains L0; no canonical Taiwan tax-shield availability receipt is yet proven.
fieldMatrix.guard: Do not apply statutory tax shield mechanically when losses/tax assets constrain usability.

fieldMatrix.evidence: Repository search finds no canonical historical target-capital-structure knownAt source.
fieldMatrix.guard: Current market weights may be studied separately; target weights remain UNKNOWN unless explicitly disclosed at the decision time.

fieldMatrix.evidence: Can be computed only from data ending at as-of.
fieldMatrix.guard: Window family must be frozen before outcomes; no winner-selected beta window.

fieldMatrix.evidence: ERP is model-dependent rather than a uniquely observed company fact.
fieldMatrix.guard: Preserve model/version and sensitivity grid; disagreement producing sign/rank flips => MODEL_UNSTABLE.

falsification: If reasonable beta/ERP/current-vs-target-weight choices materially change sign or rank, mark MODEL_UNSTABLE.
If WACC adds no information after its parent primitives and growth/valuation controls, no independent vote is allowed.
If target capital structure is unavailable at as-of, it remains UNKNOWN rather than inferred from later realized financing.
Financial institutions remain outside the ordinary industrial-company WACC lane until specialized capital semantics are defined.

maturityDecision.reason: Physical Taiwan PIT composition is incomplete: target capital structure source is unproven, tax-shield availability depends on D07-26, issuer debt-cost multi-date replay remains partial, and canonical parent receipt lineage is still required.

exactNext: Build a small outcome-blind multi-company/multi-date composition panel using only source-attested parent receipts. Use current market weights as a separately labeled scenario, keep target weights UNKNOWN unless contemporaneously disclosed, freeze beta/ERP sensitivity grid, and require D07-26 tax-shield provenance plus D22-04 multi-date debt-cost receipts before any L3 consideration.
